SELECT f.*, ma.profile_img, ma.ranking, ch.title AS chal_title, fh.feed_code AS fh_code, fh.tag_name, i.target_code, i.type, i.path, IFNULL(cnt_comment.cnt, 0) AS count_comment, IFNULL(cnt_like.cnt, 0) AS count_feed_like FROM feed f
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT fl.feed_code, count(*) AS cnt FROM feed_like fl GROUP BY fl.feed_code ) AS cnt_like ON cnt_like.feed_code = f.code
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT c.feed_code, count(*) AS cnt FROM comments c GROUP BY c.feed_code ) AS cnt_comment ON cnt_comment.feed_code = f.code
LEFT JOIN images i ON f.code = i.target_code AND i.type = 'feed'
LEFT JOIN feed_hashtag fh ON f.code = fh.feed_code
JOIN challenge ch ON f.chal_code = ch.code
JOIN member_account ma ON f.member_id = ma.id WHERE f.status = 'active' ORDER BY f.created_at DESC
SELECT f.*, ch.title AS chal_title FROM feed f JOIN challenge ch ON f.chal_code = ch.code WHERE f.status = 'active' AND f.code = #{code}
